_doc: Plan A4 coverage gate (tests/test_level_coverage.py). Every live inventory title that names a rung (basis not none) at each calibrated company, [title, family, count], as of `taken`. CI has no corpus, so the gate reads this. `floors` is the share of those titles (weighted by count) the company's own vocabulary decides (stated, company, pay_grade): it may only rise, and the gate fails when the measure falls below it or climbs two points past it. Refresh with `scripts.bench_level_bands title-snapshot`.
